content.name: Tyler Abernathy
content.title: Associate Data Scientist
content.summary: Associate data scientist at an Austin home services marketplace, a little over a year after finishing a B.S. in Statistics and Data Science. Ship small, well-tested models in Python and explain them clearly to product managers. My first production model, a technician no-show predictor, cut same-day cancellations by 14%.

experience.title: Associate Data Scientist
bullets: Trained a gradient-boosted classifier that predicts technician no-shows from booking and history features; dispatch now backfills risky jobs early, cutting same-day cancellations by 14%.
Designed and analyzed three pricing page experiments with the growth team, including power calculations and a readout template the team still uses.
Packaged feature pipelines as tested Python modules with 85% unit test coverage, so models retrain on a weekly schedule without manual steps.

experience.title: Data Science Intern
bullets: Built an hourly load forecast for 12 substations using weather and calendar features, reducing mean absolute percentage error from 8.1% to 5.6% against the existing spreadsheet method.
Mapped outage tickets to vegetation data and presented a tree-trimming priority list to the operations director.
Wrote the internship final report and demo notebook that the co-op's analytics lead used to justify a full-time data role.

education.school: The University of Texas at Austin
education.details: GPA 3.7/4.0. Capstone: predicting bike-share station shortages with spatio-temporal models.

achievements.title: Datathon winner
achievements.detail: First place out of 38 teams at a university datathon (2024) for a model predicting food pantry demand.

achievements.title: Teaching assistant
achievements.detail: TA for an introductory regression course of 120 students for two semesters.
